text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: What a great break! Ahhh, it feels like it's been forever since I've been in your office.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I ate out with my friends, went to a public bath with the old ladies from the shopping district, and more. It was so fun.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: But now it's back to the daily grind. Time to get back in the groove.
